
```{r}
library (rosmium)

#' Extract highways within an OSM relation from a PBF file
#'
#' @param name Name used to prefix all output files.
#' @param poly_id OSM id of boundary polygon, such as "r271202".
#' @param pbf Path to PBF file containing the polygon and surrounding data.
#' @return Path to the `<name>-hw.osm` file.
extract_hw <- function (name, poly_id, pbf) {

    stopifnot (file.exists (pbf))

    out_p <- paste0 (name, "-poly.pbf")
    out_j <- paste0 (name, "-poly.json")
    out_poly <- paste0 (name, "-boundary.geojson")
    out <- paste0 (name, ".pbf")
    out_hw <- paste0 (name, "-hw.osm")
    for (o in c (out_p, out_j, out, out_hw)) if (file.exists (o)) file.remove (o)

    poly_json <- osmium_getid (pbf, output = out_p, ids = poly_id, add_referenced = TRUE) |>
        osmium_export (out_j)

    p <- sf::st_read (poly_json)
    p <- p [grep ("POLYGON", sf::st_geometry_type (p)), ]
    sf::st_write (p, out_poly, delete_dsn = file.exists (out_poly))

    osmium_extract (pbf, output = out, polygon = out_poly) |>
        osmium_tags_filter (output = out_hw, expressions = "w/highway")

    file.remove (out)

    return (out_hw)
}

pbf <- "/home/smexus/Downloads/zuid-holland-261018.osm.pbf"
out_delft <- extract_hw ("delft", "r271202", pbf)
pbf <- "/home/smexus/Downloads/finland-261018.osm.pbf"
out_helsinki <- extract_hw ("helsinki", "r34914", pbf)
```

```{r}
extract_hw_speeds <- function (name) {

    out_hw <- paste0 (name, "-hw.osm")
    q <- osmdata::opq (name) |>
        osmdata::add_osm_feature (key = "highway")
    dat <- osmdata::osmdata_sf (q, doc = out_hw)
    hw <- dat$osm_lines |>
        dplyr::select (osm_id, dplyr::contains ("maxspeed"), geometry)
    hw$maxspeed <- as.numeric (hw$maxspeed)
    hw$maxspeed [which (is.na (hw$maxspeed))] <- 30
    hw$length <- sf::st_length (hw) |> unclass () |> round ()

    return (hw)
}
hw_delft <- extract_hw_speeds ("delft")
hw_helsinki <- extract_hw_speeds ("helsinki")
```

```{r}
library (ggplot2)
hw <- hw_delft
g <- ggplot (hw, aes (x = maxspeed, weight = length)) +
    geom_histogram (bins = 7, fill = "steelblue", colour = "white") +
    geom_vline (xintercept = 30, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed", lwd = 2) +
    scale_y_log10 () +
    labs (x = "Max. speed", y = "Total length (m)") +
    theme_minimal (base_size = 20) +
    theme (
        plot.background = element_rect (fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect (fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
    )
ggsave (filename = "img/delft-speeds.png", g, width = 12, bg = "transparent")
```


```{r}
library (mapdeck)
hw <- hw_delft
# Bin speeds into a few classes, with one colour and width per class
labs <- c ("≤ 30", "31–50", "51–100", "> 100")
hw$class <- cut (
    hw$maxspeed,
    breaks = c (-Inf, 30, 50, 100, Inf),
    labels = labs
)
cols <- rev (colourvalues::colour_values (seq_along (labs), palette = "plasma"))
cols [1] <- "#F8C61EFF" # slightly darker, more orange than plasma's yellow
hw$colour <- cols [as.integer (hw$class)]
hw$width <- c (2, 3, 5, 8) [as.integer (hw$class)] * 5

legend <- mapdeck_legend (
    legend_element (
        variables = labs,
        colours = cols,
        colour_type = "stroke",
        variable_type = "category",
        title = "Max. speed (km/h)"
    )
)

mapdeck (hw, style = mapdeck_style ("light")) |>
    add_path (
        stroke_colour = "colour",
        stroke_width = "width",
        legend = legend
    )
```
